identificationModule.officialTitle: Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-cell and Cellular Therapies for the Treatment of cAncer or BLood Diseases: Evaluation of Reporting of Adverse Events

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: CAR-T cells and cellular therapies are responsible of a wide range of side effects.The investigators use VigiBase, the World Health Organization (WHO) database of individual safety case reports, to identify cases of adverse drug reactions following treatment with cellular therapies

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of patients with adverse events with significant over-reporting CAR-T cells and other cellular therapies
primaryOutcomes.description: Identification and report of various toxicities of cellular therapies.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Case reported in the World Health Organization (WHO) of individual safety case reports to January 2020

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Causality assessment of reported adverse events according to the WHO system

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Description of the type of adverse event depending on the class and the target of cellular therapy
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Case reported in the World Health Organization (WHO) of individual safety case reports to January 2020

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Description of the duration of treatment when the toxicity happens and the time to onset

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Description of the drug-drug interactions associated with adverse events
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Case reported in the World Health Organization (WHO) of individual safety case reports to January 2020

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Description of the pathologies (cancer) for which the incriminated drugs have been prescribed

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Case reported in the World Health Organization (WHO) database of individual safety case reports to 01/01/2020
* Adverse events reported were including any MedDRA terms
* Patients treated with cellular therapies reported in the WHO database.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Chronology not compatible between the drug and the toxicity
eligibilityModule.studyPopulation: Patients treated with cellular therapy for solid or hematologic cancer
